title_zh: 北宋：与辽、西夏、大理并立
title_en: Northern Song: Coexisting with Liao, Western Xia, and Dali
description_zh: 从宋灭北汉后的再统一边界开始，讲北宋如何与辽形成澶渊和平，又因西夏立国转入三角对峙，并在改革与党争之后遭遇辽亡、金起和靖康之变。
description_en: From Song’s post-Northern Han reunification frontier, this storyline follows Chanyuan peace with Liao, the rise of Western Xia and triangular rivalry, reform and factional conflict, then Liao’s fall, Jin’s rise, and the Jingkang crisis.
source_note_zh: 地图边界使用 Cliopatria 北宋、辽、西夏、大理、金与南宋参考层；1127 前 Cliopatria 的 Southern Song 中原层按北宋叙事归入北宋。
source_note_en: Map boundaries use Cliopatria layers for Northern Song, Liao, Western Xia, Dali, Jin, and Southern Song; pre-1127 Cliopatria Southern Song central-plains layers are treated as Northern Song for narrative purposes.

chapters.title_zh: 灭北汉之后：统一为什么并不完整
chapters.title_en: After Northern Han: Why Reunification Was Incomplete
chapters.script_zh: 979 年宋灭北汉，五代十国主体结束。但燕云十六州仍在辽手中，大理稳居西南，宋朝的地图从一开始就不是汉唐式完整一统。
chapters.script_en: In 979 Song conquered Northern Han, ending the main Five Dynasties order. But Yan-Yun remained in Liao hands and Dali held the southwest, so Song’s map was never a full Han-Tang restoration.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 灭北汉之后：统一为什么并不完整
chapters.scene_setting_en: After Northern Han: Why Reunification Was Incomplete
chapters.character_beat_zh: 北宋在多政权压力中寻找稳定、安全与改革路径。

chapters.story_question_zh: 北宋为什么不是汉唐式大一统，而是多政权并立中的一极？
chapters.story_question_en: Why was Northern Song not a Han-Tang style unified empire, but one pole in a multipolar order?

chapters.title_zh: 北宋、辽、西夏、大理：同一张地图上的四个重心
chapters.title_en: Song, Liao, Western Xia, Dali: Four Centers on One Map
chapters.script_zh: 1004 年的地图已经能看出北宋、辽、西夏雏形和大理并立。大理不是宋辽战争主角，却说明宋代中国周边还有稳定的西南政权。
chapters.script_en: The 1004 map already shows Northern Song, Liao, an emerging Western Xia, and Dali. Dali is not the protagonist of Song-Liao war, but it shows a stable southwestern polity in the Song-era world.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 北宋、辽、西夏、大理：同一张地图上的四个重心

chapters.title_zh: 澶渊之盟：宋辽从战争转向制度化和平
chapters.title_en: Chanyuan: Song and Liao Turn War into Institutional Peace
chapters.script_zh: 澶渊之盟让宋辽停止长期消耗：宋给岁币，辽承认边界。它不是彻底胜利，却给北宋换来长期北方和平。
chapters.script_en: Chanyuan ended costly Song-Liao conflict: Song paid annual gifts and Liao recognized the border. It was not total victory, but it bought Song long northern peace.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 澶渊之盟：宋辽从战争转向制度化和平
chapters.scene_setting_en: Chanyuan: Song and Liao Turn War into Institutional Peace

chapters.title_zh: 西夏立国：西北变成第三条战线
chapters.title_en: Western Xia Founded: The Northwest Becomes a Third Front
chapters.script_zh: 李元昊称帝后，宋朝面对的不只是辽。西夏控制西北关键地带，使宋、辽、西夏形成三角对峙。
chapters.script_en: After Li Yuanhao proclaimed emperor, Song faced more than Liao. Western Xia controlled key northwest space, creating a Song-Liao-Western Xia triangle.

chapters.scene_setting_en: Western Xia Founded: The Northwest Becomes a Third Front

chapters.title_zh: 宋夏和议：战争暴露了国家能力问题
chapters.title_en: Song-Xia Peace: War Exposes State Capacity Problems
chapters.script_zh: 宋夏战争后，1044 年双方和议。边境压力让范仲淹等人推动改革讨论：怎样让北宋有钱、有兵、有基层执行力。
chapters.script_en: After Song-Xia war, the two sides settled in 1044. Frontier pressure pushed Fan Zhongyan and others toward reform: how could Song gain money, troops, and local capacity?
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 宋夏和议：战争暴露了国家能力问题

chapters.title_zh: 王安石变法：改革是边疆压力的内政答案
chapters.title_en: Wang Anshi Reforms: Domestic Answer to Frontier Pressure
chapters.script_zh: 王安石变法要解决的不是抽象弊政，而是宋辽西夏格局下的财政、军政和基层治理问题。富国强兵背后，是北宋长期处在多政权压力中。
chapters.script_en: Wang Anshi’s reforms were not abstract policy cleanup; they addressed finance, military administration, and local governance under Song-Liao-Western Xia pressure. State strengthening came from multipolar pressure.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 王安石变法：改革是边疆压力的内政答案
chapters.scene_setting_en: Wang Anshi Reforms: Domestic Answer to Frontier Pressure

chapters.title_zh: 元祐更化：改革路线为何难以稳定
chapters.title_en: Yuanyou Reversal: Why Reform Could Not Stabilize
chapters.script_zh: 神宗去世后，司马光等旧党掌权，新法被废止或调整。北宋的问题不只是是否改革，而是政策路线难以稳定延续。
chapters.script_en: After Shenzong died, Sima Guang and conservatives took power; New Policies were repealed or revised. Song’s problem was not just whether to reform, but whether policy could remain stable.

chapters.title_zh: 辽亡金起：旧平衡被打破
chapters.title_en: Liao Falls, Jin Rises: The Old Balance Breaks
chapters.script_zh: 宋原本想借金灭辽收复燕云，但辽亡后，北方不是空出来，而是由更具冲击力的金朝接手。宋辽均衡被打破。
chapters.script_en: Song hoped to use Jin against Liao and recover Yan-Yun. But after Liao fell, the north was not empty; it was taken by a more forceful Jin. The Song-Liao balance broke.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 辽亡金起：旧平衡被打破
chapters.scene_setting_en: Liao Falls, Jin Rises: The Old Balance Breaks

chapters.title_zh: 靖康之变：北宋终局与南宋开场
chapters.title_en: Jingkang: Northern Song Ends, Southern Song Begins
chapters.script_zh: 1127 年金军攻破汴京，徽钦二帝被俘，北宋灭亡。地图从北宋、辽、西夏、大理的格局，转入金、南宋、西夏、大理以及西辽并立。
chapters.script_en: In 1127 Jin captured Bianjing, Huizong and Qinzong were taken, and Northern Song ended. The map moves from Song-Liao-Western Xia-Dali into Jin, Southern Song, Western Xia, Dali, and Western Liao.

title_zh: 南宋：金、西辽与蒙古崛起
title_en: Southern Song: Jin, Western Liao, and the Mongol Rise
description_zh: 从靖康后南宋建立开始，讲南宋与金的南北对峙、西辽延续辽的西迁遗绪，以及蒙古如何先后压垮西夏、金、大理和南宋，最终进入元朝统一。
description_en: From Southern Song’s founding after Jingkang, this storyline follows the north-south rivalry with Jin, Western Liao as the westward continuation of Liao, and the Mongol conquest of Western Xia, Jin, Dali, and Southern Song, leading into Yuan rule.
source_note_zh: 地图边界使用 Cliopatria 南宋、金、西辽、西夏、大理与蒙古帝国参考层；1271 前后 Cliopatria 仍以 Mongol Empire 表示元初大框架。
source_note_en: Map boundaries use Cliopatria layers for Southern Song, Jin, Western Liao, Western Xia, Dali, and the Mongol Empire; around 1271 Cliopatria still represents early Yuan through the broader Mongol Empire layer.

chapters.title_zh: 南宋开场：从汴京到临安
chapters.title_en: Southern Song Begins: From Bianjing to Lin’an
chapters.script_zh: 靖康之后，宋室南渡，在临安重建政权。地图上北方由金控制，南方为南宋，西北有西夏，西南有大理，辽的遗绪则转向西辽。
chapters.script_en: After Jingkang, the Song court moved south and rebuilt at Lin’an. The map shows Jin in the north, Southern Song in the south, Western Xia in the northwest, Dali in the southwest, and Liao continuity as Western Liao.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 南宋开场：从汴京到临安
chapters.scene_setting_en: Southern Song Begins: From Bianjing to Lin’an
chapters.character_beat_zh: 南宋在金与蒙古之间寻找生存空间，最终被元的统一进程吞没。
chapters.character_beat_en: Southern Song searches for survival between Jin and the Mongols, and is eventually absorbed by Yuan unification.
chapters.story_question_zh: 南宋为什么能长期维持，又为什么最终挡不住蒙古/元？
chapters.story_question_en: Why did Southern Song endure so long, and why could it not ultimately stop Mongol/Yuan conquest?

chapters.title_zh: 绍兴和议：恢复中原还是保存江南
chapters.title_en: Shaoxing Peace: Recover the North or Preserve Jiangnan
chapters.script_zh: 1141 年宋金和议固定南北对峙。岳飞北伐与秦桧主和，代表南宋政治中最尖锐的路线冲突。
chapters.script_en: The 1141 settlement fixed the north-south division. Yue Fei’s campaigns and Qin Hui’s peace policy represent Southern Song’s sharpest strategic conflict.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 绍兴和议：恢复中原还是保存江南
chapters.scene_setting_en: Shaoxing Peace: Recover the North or Preserve Jiangnan
chapters.character_beat_zh: 南宋在金与蒙古之间寻找生存空间，最终被元的统一进程吞没。
chapters.character_beat_en: Southern Song searches for survival between Jin and the Mongols, and is eventually absorbed by Yuan unification.

chapters.story_question_en: Why did Southern Song endure so long, and why could it not ultimately stop Mongol/Yuan conquest?

chapters.title_zh: 西辽：辽没有完全从地图上消失
chapters.title_en: Western Liao: Liao Did Not Vanish Entirely
chapters.script_zh: 辽亡后，耶律大石在西域建立西辽。它不再参与宋金主战场，却说明“辽”的历史在中亚继续，直到蒙古扩张改变内陆格局。
chapters.script_en: After Liao fell, Yelu Dashi founded Western Liao. It no longer fought on the Song-Jin front, but Liao history continued in Central Asia until Mongol expansion changed Inner Eurasia.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 西辽：辽没有完全从地图上消失
chapters.scene_setting_en: Western Liao: Liao Did Not Vanish Entirely

chapters.title_zh: 蒙古统一：新的压力从草原出现
chapters.title_en: Mongol Unification: New Pressure from the Steppe
chapters.script_zh: 1206 年成吉思汗统一蒙古。此时南宋、金、西夏、大理、西辽还都在地图上，但真正改变格局的新力量已经出现。
chapters.script_en: In 1206 Genghis Khan unified the Mongols. Southern Song, Jin, Western Xia, Dali, and Western Liao still appear on the map, but the new force that would change everything had emerged.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 蒙古统一：新的压力从草原出现
chapters.scene_setting_en: Mongol Unification: New Pressure from the Steppe
chapters.character_beat_zh: 南宋在金与蒙古之间寻找生存空间，最终被元的统一进程吞没。
chapters.character_beat_en: Southern Song searches for survival between Jin and the Mongols, and is eventually absorbed by Yuan unification.

chapters.title_zh: 蒙古攻金：宋金平衡开始松动
chapters.title_en: Mongols Attack Jin: The Song-Jin Balance Loosens
chapters.script_zh: 蒙古攻金让金朝从北方承压。南宋看见机会，但更重要的是：北方霸主正在被一个更强扩张性政权替换。
chapters.script_en: The Mongol attack put Jin under northern pressure. Southern Song saw an opportunity, but more importantly, the northern hegemon was being replaced by an even more expansionary power.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 蒙古攻金：宋金平衡开始松动
chapters.scene_setting_en: Mongols Attack Jin: The Song-Jin Balance Loosens
chapters.character_beat_zh: 南宋在金与蒙古之间寻找生存空间，最终被元的统一进程吞没。

chapters.story_question_en: Why did Southern Song endure so long, and why could it not ultimately stop Mongol/Yuan conquest?

chapters.title_zh: 中都失守：金朝北方霸权崩裂
chapters.title_en: Zhongdu Falls: Jin’s Northern Hegemony Cracks
chapters.script_zh: 1215 年蒙古攻陷中都，金朝被迫转向更南方的防守。宋金对峙仍在，但决定性变量已经变成蒙古。
chapters.script_en: In 1215 the Mongols captured Zhongdu, forcing Jin into more southern defense. Song-Jin rivalry remained, but the decisive variable had become the Mongols.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 中都失守：金朝北方霸权崩裂
chapters.scene_setting_en: Zhongdu Falls: Jin’s Northern Hegemony Cracks
chapters.character_beat_zh: 南宋在金与蒙古之间寻找生存空间，最终被元的统一进程吞没。

chapters.title_zh: 西夏灭亡：西北屏障消失
chapters.title_en: Western Xia Falls: The Northwest Buffer Disappears
chapters.script_zh: 1227 年西夏被蒙古灭亡。Cliopatria 在这一年不再显示西夏独立层，地图上能直观看到西北政权退出，蒙古压力转向金与南宋。
chapters.script_en: In 1227 Western Xia was destroyed by the Mongols. Cliopatria no longer shows it as independent at this node, so the map directly shows the northwest polity exiting while Mongol pressure turns toward Jin and Song.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 西夏灭亡：西北屏障消失
chapters.scene_setting_en: Western Xia Falls: The Northwest Buffer Disappears

chapters.character_beat_en: Southern Song searches for survival between Jin and the Mongols, and is eventually absorbed by Yuan unification.

chapters.story_question_en: Why did Southern Song endure so long, and why could it not ultimately stop Mongol/Yuan conquest?

chapters.title_zh: 金亡：旧敌消失，新敌更强
chapters.title_en: Jin Falls: Old Enemy Gone, Stronger Enemy Remains
chapters.script_zh: 1234 年金亡。南宋与蒙古短暂合作消灭旧敌，但金一消失，蒙古就成为南宋北方边界上的直接对手。
chapters.script_en: In 1234 Jin fell. Southern Song and the Mongols briefly cooperated against an old enemy, but once Jin disappeared, the Mongols became Song’s direct northern opponent.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 金亡：旧敌消失，新敌更强
chapters.scene_setting_en: Jin Falls: Old Enemy Gone, Stronger Enemy Remains
chapters.character_beat_zh: 南宋在金与蒙古之间寻找生存空间，最终被元的统一进程吞没。

chapters.story_question_en: Why did Southern Song endure so long, and why could it not ultimately stop Mongol/Yuan conquest?

chapters.title_zh: 大理被取：蒙古打开西南方向
chapters.title_en: Dali Taken: Mongols Open the Southwest
chapters.script_zh: 1253 年蒙古控制大理。大理从宋代西南独立政权，变成蒙古绕攻南宋的战略入口。
chapters.script_en: In 1253 the Mongols took Dali. Dali shifted from an independent southwestern polity into a Mongol strategic entry toward Southern Song.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 大理被取：蒙古打开西南方向
chapters.scene_setting_en: Dali Taken: Mongols Open the Southwest

chapters.story_question_en: Why did Southern Song endure so long, and why could it not ultimately stop Mongol/Yuan conquest?

chapters.title_zh: 忽必烈：从征服到治理
chapters.title_en: Kublai: From Conquest to Governance
chapters.script_zh: 忽必烈即大汗位后，蒙古对南宋的战争越来越带有建立中原政权的目标。南宋面对的不再只是草原远征，而是制度化的征服。
chapters.script_en: After Kublai became Great Khan, the war against Southern Song increasingly aimed at building a Chinese-style state. Song faced not only steppe raids but institutionalized conquest.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 忽必烈：从征服到治理
chapters.scene_setting_en: Kublai: From Conquest to Governance

chapters.title_zh: 建元：蒙古帝国中的元朝
chapters.title_en: Yuan Founded within the Mongol Empire
chapters.script_zh: 1271 年忽必烈建元。Cliopatria 此时仍用蒙古帝国大框架显示，因为元朝是在蒙古帝国体系中成立的；故事上，这里是元统一中国的制度起点。
chapters.script_en: In 1271 Kublai founded Yuan. Cliopatria still uses the broader Mongol Empire layer because Yuan was founded within the Mongol imperial system; narratively this is the institutional start of Yuan unification.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 建元：蒙古帝国中的元朝
chapters.scene_setting_en: Yuan Founded within the Mongol Empire

chapters.title_zh: 临安陷落：南宋中央朝廷瓦解
chapters.title_en: Lin’an Falls: Southern Song Central Court Collapses
chapters.script_zh: 1276 年临安陷落，南宋中央朝廷投降。南宋还没有完全结束，但政治中心已经被元军夺取。
chapters.script_en: In 1276 Lin’an fell and the Southern Song central court surrendered. Southern Song had not fully ended, but its political center had been taken.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 临安陷落：南宋中央朝廷瓦解
chapters.scene_setting_en: Lin’an Falls: Southern Song Central Court Collapses

chapters.title_zh: 崖山：宋朝终局与元的完成
chapters.title_en: Yamen: The End of Song and Completion of Yuan
chapters.script_zh: 1279 年崖山海战后，南宋最后抵抗失败。地图上南宋层消失，只剩蒙古帝国/元的大框架，中国本部进入元朝统一。
chapters.script_en: After Yamen in 1279, the last Southern Song resistance failed. The Southern Song layer disappears from the map, leaving the Mongol/Yuan frame over China proper.

title_zh: 元朝：蒙古帝国中的中国王朝
title_en: Yuan Dynasty: A Chinese Dynasty within the Mongol Empire
description_zh: 从崖山后元完成统一开始，讲元朝如何从蒙古帝国框架中形成独立王朝层，如何处理大都朝廷、行省治理、科举文治和蒙古诸汗国关系，并最终在红巾起义与朱元璋北伐中退往北方。
description_en: From Yuan’s completed conquest after Yamen, this storyline follows how Yuan emerged from the Mongol imperial frame, governed through Dadu, provincial administration, civil policy, and khanate relations, then retreated north amid Red Turban rebellion and Zhu Yuanzhang’s campaign.
source_note_zh: 地图边界使用 Cliopatria 蒙古帝国、元朝、察合台汗国、金帐汗国、伊儿汗国、明朝与北元参考层；1368 年 Cliopatria 仍显示大范围元层，1375 年明与北元分立更清楚。
source_note_en: Map boundaries use Cliopatria layers for the Mongol Empire, Yuan Dynasty, Chagatai Khanate, Golden Horde, Ilkhanate, Ming, and Northern Yuan; Cliopatria still shows a broad Yuan layer in 1368, while Ming and Northern Yuan separate more clearly by 1375.

route_points.note_zh: 宋亡后，元朝成为中国本部统治者。
route_points.note_en: After Song fell, Yuan ruled China proper.

route_points.note_zh: 元朝层从蒙古帝国框架中更清楚显示。
route_points.note_en: Yuan appears more distinctly within the Mongol world.

route_points.note_zh: 元中期宫廷与贵族政治调整。
route_points.note_en: Mid-Yuan court and aristocratic politics shift.

route_points.note_zh: 恢复科举，强化文治治理。
route_points.note_en: Examinations returned and civil governance strengthened.

route_points.note_zh: 财政和政治改革触动贵族利益。
route_points.note_en: Fiscal and political reforms touched aristocratic interests.

route_points.note_zh: 皇位争夺加剧中央失序。
route_points.note_en: Succession struggle deepened central disorder.

route_points.note_zh: 元朝进入最后长期统治阶段。
route_points.note_en: Yuan enters its final long reign.

route_points.note_zh: 元末地方控制开始崩解。
route_points.note_en: Late-Yuan local control begins to collapse.

route_points.note_zh: 朱元璋等地方力量开始崛起。
route_points.note_en: Regional powers including Zhu Yuanzhang rise.

route_points.note_zh: 元退出中原，明朝兴起。
route_points.note_en: Yuan leaves China proper and Ming rises.

route_points.note_zh: 地图上明与北元分立清楚。
route_points.note_en: Ming and Northern Yuan divide clearly on the map.

chapters.title_zh: 元完成统一：蒙古帝国框架中的中国本部
chapters.title_en: Yuan Completes Unification: China Proper within the Mongol Frame
chapters.script_zh: 1279 年南宋灭亡，元朝完成对中国本部的统一。Cliopatria 此时仍显示蒙古帝国大框架，说明元朝早期仍嵌在蒙古帝国结构内。
chapters.script_en: In 1279 Southern Song fell and Yuan completed rule over China proper. Cliopatria still shows the broader Mongol Empire, reflecting early Yuan’s place within Mongol imperial structures.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 元完成统一：蒙古帝国框架中的中国本部
chapters.scene_setting_en: Yuan Completes Unification: China Proper within the Mongol Frame
chapters.character_beat_zh: 元朝在蒙古帝国与中原王朝身份之间调整，最终被明朝取代。
chapters.character_beat_en: Yuan adjusts between Mongol imperial and Chinese dynastic identities, and is eventually replaced by Ming.
chapters.story_question_zh: 元朝是蒙古帝国的一部分，还是中国王朝？它为什么最终退回北方？
chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 忽必烈之后：元朝层清晰出现
chapters.title_en: After Kublai: Yuan Appears Clearly
chapters.script_zh: 1294 年忽必烈去世、元成宗继位。地图上元朝、察合台汗国、金帐汗国、伊儿汗国并列出现，蒙古世界从统一征服转向多中心秩序。
chapters.script_en: In 1294 Kublai died and Temur succeeded. The map shows Yuan, Chagatai, Golden Horde, and Ilkhanate side by side, as the Mongol world shifts from unified conquest to a multi-center order.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 忽必烈之后：元朝层清晰出现
chapters.scene_setting_en: After Kublai: Yuan Appears Clearly
chapters.character_beat_zh: 元朝在蒙古帝国与中原王朝身份之间调整，最终被明朝取代。
chapters.character_beat_en: Yuan adjusts between Mongol imperial and Chinese dynastic identities, and is eventually replaced by Ming.

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 成宗之后：皇位继承与蒙古贵族政治
chapters.title_en: After Temur: Succession and Mongol Aristocratic Politics
chapters.script_zh: 成宗死后，武宗海山继位。元朝中期的政治，不只是皇帝更替，也是大都朝廷、蒙古贵族和宗王集团之间的权力平衡。
chapters.script_en: After Temur died, Kulug Khan succeeded. Mid-Yuan politics was not only imperial succession but a balance among the Dadu court, Mongol aristocracy, and princely groups.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 成宗之后：皇位继承与蒙古贵族政治
chapters.scene_setting_en: After Temur: Succession and Mongol Aristocratic Politics
chapters.character_beat_zh: 元朝在蒙古帝国与中原王朝身份之间调整，最终被明朝取代。
chapters.character_beat_en: Yuan adjusts between Mongol imperial and Chinese dynastic identities, and is eventually replaced by Ming.
chapters.story_question_zh: 元朝是蒙古帝国的一部分，还是中国王朝？它为什么最终退回北方？
chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 仁宗文治：蒙古王朝如何治理中原
chapters.title_en: Renzong Civil Rule: How a Mongol Dynasty Governed China
chapters.script_zh: 元仁宗重用儒臣、恢复科举。元朝一面是蒙古大汗政权，一面又必须用中原制度治理庞大农业社会。
chapters.script_en: Renzong used Confucian officials and restored examinations. Yuan was both a Mongol khanate regime and a state that had to govern a vast agrarian Chinese society.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 仁宗文治：蒙古王朝如何治理中原
chapters.scene_setting_en: Renzong Civil Rule: How a Mongol Dynasty Governed China
chapters.character_beat_zh: 元朝在蒙古帝国与中原王朝身份之间调整，最终被明朝取代。
chapters.character_beat_en: Yuan adjusts between Mongol imperial and Chinese dynastic identities, and is eventually replaced by Ming.

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 英宗改革：财政、贵族与官僚的冲突
chapters.title_en: Yingzong Reforms: Finance, Nobles, and Bureaucracy
chapters.script_zh: 英宗试图整顿财政和政治秩序，却触动贵族利益。元朝的困难，逐渐从征服后的治理问题转为制度内部冲突。
chapters.script_en: Yingzong tried to reorganize finance and politics, touching aristocratic interests. Yuan’s difficulties shifted from post-conquest governance into internal institutional conflict.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 英宗改革：财政、贵族与官僚的冲突
chapters.scene_setting_en: Yingzong Reforms: Finance, Nobles, and Bureaucracy

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 两都之战：中央权力开始失序
chapters.title_en: War of the Two Capitals: Central Power Loses Order
chapters.script_zh: 两都之战暴露元朝皇位继承的脆弱。地图上元朝仍大，但政治中心内部已经出现反复震荡。
chapters.script_en: The War of the Two Capitals exposed fragile succession. The map still shows a large Yuan, but the political center is repeatedly shaken.

chapters.scene_setting_en: War of the Two Capitals: Central Power Loses Order

chapters.character_beat_en: Yuan adjusts between Mongol imperial and Chinese dynastic identities, and is eventually replaced by Ming.

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 顺帝即位：元末长危机开始
chapters.title_en: Toghon Temur Accedes: The Long Late-Yuan Crisis Begins
chapters.script_zh: 元顺帝即位后，元朝进入最后长期统治阶段。财政、河患、灾荒、党争和地方失控逐渐叠加。
chapters.script_en: After Toghon Temur acceded, Yuan entered its final long reign. Fiscal stress, river disasters, famine, factionalism, and local loss of control accumulated.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 顺帝即位：元末长危机开始
chapters.scene_setting_en: Toghon Temur Accedes: The Long Late-Yuan Crisis Begins

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 红巾起义：元末危机爆发
chapters.title_en: Red Turbans: Late-Yuan Crisis Erupts
chapters.script_zh: 1351 年红巾起义爆发。地图上元朝仍然庞大，但现实控制力已经开始被地方起义和军阀割裂。
chapters.script_en: In 1351 the Red Turban rebellion erupted. The map still shows a huge Yuan, but real control is being fractured by local rebellions and warlords.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 红巾起义：元末危机爆发
chapters.scene_setting_en: Red Turbans: Late-Yuan Crisis Erupts
chapters.character_beat_zh: 元朝在蒙古帝国与中原王朝身份之间调整，最终被明朝取代。

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 元末群雄：朱元璋开始崛起
chapters.title_en: Late Yuan Fragmentation: Zhu Yuanzhang Rises
chapters.script_zh: 红巾之后，各地武装扩大。朱元璋从江淮军政格局中崛起，元朝衰亡开始转化为新王朝竞争。
chapters.script_en: After the Red Turbans, armed regional powers expanded. Zhu Yuanzhang rose from the Jiang-Huai military-political world, and Yuan decline turned into competition for a new dynasty.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 元末群雄：朱元璋开始崛起
chapters.scene_setting_en: Late Yuan Fragmentation: Zhu Yuanzhang Rises

chapters.character_beat_en: Yuan adjusts between Mongol imperial and Chinese dynastic identities, and is eventually replaced by Ming.

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 1368：明军入大都，元退北
chapters.title_en: 1368: Ming Enters Dadu, Yuan Retreats North
chapters.script_zh: 1368 年朱元璋建明并北伐，明军攻入大都，元顺帝北逃。Cliopatria 仍显示大范围元层，所以这里要理解为政治转折先于地图层完全切换。
chapters.script_en: In 1368 Zhu Yuanzhang founded Ming and campaigned north; Ming forces entered Dadu and Toghon Temur fled. Cliopatria still shows a broad Yuan layer, so the political turn comes before the map fully switches.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 1368：明军入大都，元退北
chapters.scene_setting_en: 1368: Ming Enters Dadu, Yuan Retreats North

chapters.story_question_en: Was Yuan part of the Mongol Empire or a Chinese dynasty, and why did it ultimately retreat north?

chapters.title_zh: 明与北元：元朝故事转入后续对峙
chapters.title_en: Ming and Northern Yuan: Yuan Story Becomes a New Rivalry
chapters.script_zh: 到 1375 年，地图上明朝与北元分立更清楚。元朝没有简单消失，而是退出中原，转为明初北方草原对峙的一方。
chapters.script_en: By 1375 the map more clearly separates Ming and Northern Yuan. Yuan did not simply vanish; it left China proper and became one side of the early Ming steppe rivalry.

title_zh: 明朝：重建、北防、改革与明亡清兴
title_en: Ming Dynasty: Reconstruction, Northern Defense, Reform, and Qing Rise
description_zh: 从朱元璋建明和北元分立开始，讲洪武集权、永乐扩张与迁都、郑和下西洋、土木堡后的北防转向，中后期财政改革、蒙古与后金压力，以及 1644/1645 明亡清兴。
description_en: From Zhu Yuanzhang’s Ming and the Northern Yuan split, this storyline follows Hongwu centralization, Yongle expansion and Beijing, Zheng He, the post-Tumu northern-defense turn, late-Ming fiscal reform, Mongol and Later Jin pressure, and the 1644/1645 Ming-Qing transition.
source_note_zh: 地图边界使用 Cliopatria 明朝、北元、瓦剌、蒙古汗国、土默特、后金、清朝与南明参考层；1368 明兴起已在元朝线说明，1375 起地图更清楚显示明与北元分立。
source_note_en: Map boundaries use Cliopatria layers for Ming, Northern Yuan, Oirats, Mongol Khanate, Tümed, Later Jin, Qing, and Southern Ming; Ming’s 1368 rise is explained in the Yuan storyline, while the map clearly separates Ming and Northern Yuan from 1375 onward.

route_points.note_zh: 明朝与北元分立清晰出现在地图上。
route_points.note_en: Ming and Northern Yuan appear clearly divided on the map.

route_points.note_zh: 废丞相，皇权直接统合六部。
route_points.note_en: The chancellor was abolished and imperial power directly coordinated ministries.

route_points.note_zh: 朱棣夺位，北方战略重心抬升。
route_points.note_en: Zhu Di seized power and raised the northern strategic focus.

route_points.note_zh: 明初海上朝贡秩序扩张。
route_points.note_en: Early Ming maritime tribute expanded.

route_points.note_zh: 首都贴近北方边防。
route_points.note_en: The capital moved close to the northern frontier.

route_points.note_zh: 仁宗即位，治理转向宽缓。
route_points.note_en: Hongxi acceded and governance moderated.

route_points.note_zh: 仁宣之治进入稳定完成。
route_points.note_en: Renxuan governance reached stable completion.

route_points.note_zh: 明英宗被瓦剌俘虏。
route_points.note_en: Ming Yingzong was captured by the Oirats.

route_points.note_zh: 武宗朝与刘瑾专权开始。
route_points.note_en: Zhengde reign and Liu Jin’s power began.

route_points.note_zh: 武宗无子而终，嘉靖继位。
route_points.note_en: Zhengde died without an heir; Jiajing succeeded.

route_points.note_zh: 蒙古边患再度尖锐。
route_points.note_en: Mongol frontier pressure sharpened again.

route_points.note_zh: 一条鞭法与行政考成强化国家能力。
route_points.note_en: Single Whip and administrative audits strengthened state capacity.

route_points.note_zh: 财政、边防与战争成本叠加。
route_points.note_en: Fiscal, frontier, and war costs accumulated.

route_points.note_zh: 努尔哈赤建立后金。
route_points.note_en: Nurhaci founded Later Jin.

route_points.note_zh: 天启朝夹在辽东危机和党争之间。
route_points.note_en: Tianqi reign sat between Liaodong crisis and factionalism.

route_points.note_zh: 宦官政治与东林党争激化。
route_points.note_en: Eunuch politics and Donglin conflict intensified.

route_points.note_zh: 后金和内乱压力叠加。
route_points.note_en: Later Jin and internal unrest converged.

route_points.note_zh: 李自成入北京，崇祯自缢。
route_points.note_en: Li Zicheng entered Beijing and Chongzhen died.

route_points.note_zh: 清朝与南明分立。
route_points.note_en: Qing and Southern Ming divide.

chapters.title_zh: 明与北元：新王朝还要面对草原旧敌
chapters.title_en: Ming and Northern Yuan: New Dynasty, Old Steppe Rival
chapters.script_zh: 1375 年地图上明朝与北元分立清楚。明朝不是在真空中建立，而是在元退北、蒙古世界仍存的格局中重建中原秩序。
chapters.script_en: By 1375 Ming and Northern Yuan are clearly separate on the map. Ming was not built in a vacuum; it rebuilt China proper while Yuan retreated north and the Mongol world remained.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 明与北元：新王朝还要面对草原旧敌
chapters.scene_setting_en: Ming and Northern Yuan: New Dynasty, Old Steppe Rival
chapters.character_beat_zh: 明朝在重建秩序、应对北方压力和财政改革之间反复调整，最终被内外危机击穿。
chapters.character_beat_en: Ming repeatedly adjusts among rebuilding order, managing northern pressure, and fiscal reform, before internal and external crises break through.
chapters.story_question_zh: 明朝为什么能重建长期秩序，又为什么在东北外患和内部危机中崩溃？
chapters.story_question_en: Why could Ming rebuild a long order, and why did it collapse under northeastern pressure and internal crisis?

chapters.title_zh: 洪武集权：战争之后重建国家机器
chapters.title_en: Hongwu Centralization: Rebuilding the State after War
chapters.script_zh: 朱元璋通过户籍、里甲、卫所和废丞相重建国家。明初制度的核心，是让皇权直接抓住财政、军户和地方社会。
chapters.script_en: Zhu Yuanzhang rebuilt the state through registers, lijia, guards, and abolishing the chancellor. Early Ming institutions put finance, military households, and local society directly under imperial power.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 洪武集权：战争之后重建国家机器
chapters.scene_setting_en: Hongwu Centralization: Rebuilding the State after War
chapters.character_beat_zh: 明朝在重建秩序、应对北方压力和财政改革之间反复调整，最终被内外危机击穿。
chapters.character_beat_en: Ming repeatedly adjusts among rebuilding order, managing northern pressure, and fiscal reform, before internal and external crises break through.
chapters.story_question_zh: 明朝为什么能重建长期秩序，又为什么在东北外患和内部危机中崩溃？
chapters.story_question_en: Why could Ming rebuild a long order, and why did it collapse under northeastern pressure and internal crisis?

chapters.title_zh: 靖难之役：藩王制度反噬中央
chapters.title_en: Jingnan: Princely Power Turns against the Center
chapters.script_zh: 建文帝削藩引发朱棣起兵。靖难之后，明朝的政治和军事重心逐渐转向北方，永乐时代开启。
chapters.script_en: Jianwen’s reduction of princely power triggered Zhu Di’s rebellion. After Jingnan, Ming’s political and military focus moved north and the Yongle era began.

chapters.story_question_en: Why could Ming rebuild a long order, and why did it collapse under northeastern pressure and internal crisis?

chapters.title_zh: 郑和下西洋：永乐朝的海上外向性
chapters.title_en: Zheng He Voyages: Yongle’s Maritime Outwardness
chapters.script_zh: 永乐朝一面北征蒙古，一面派郑和下西洋。明朝的威望不只靠陆上边防，也通过海上朝贡和使节网络展开。
chapters.script_en: Yongle campaigned north against Mongols while sending Zheng He to sea. Ming prestige expanded not only through land defense but maritime tribute and envoys.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 郑和下西洋：永乐朝的海上外向性
chapters.scene_setting_en: Zheng He Voyages: Yongle’s Maritime Outwardness
chapters.character_beat_zh: 明朝在重建秩序、应对北方压力和财政改革之间反复调整，最终被内外危机击穿。

chapters.story_question_en: Why could Ming rebuild a long order, and why did it collapse under northeastern pressure and internal crisis?

chapters.title_zh: 迁都北京：把首都放到边防前线
chapters.title_en: Beijing Capital: Placing the Capital near the Frontier
chapters.script_zh: 1421 年北京成为明朝政治中心。这个选择把皇权、军镇和北方边防绑在一起，也让明朝长期面向蒙古压力。
chapters.script_en: In 1421 Beijing became Ming’s political center. This tied imperial power, military commands, and northern defense together, keeping Ming oriented toward Mongol pressure.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 迁都北京：把首都放到边防前线
chapters.scene_setting_en: Beijing Capital: Placing the Capital near the Frontier
chapters.character_beat_zh: 明朝在重建秩序、应对北方压力和财政改革之间反复调整，最终被内外危机击穿。

chapters.story_question_en: Why could Ming rebuild a long order, and why did it collapse under northeastern pressure and internal crisis?

chapters.title_zh: 仁宣之治开端：永乐之后的宽缓治理
chapters.title_en: Renxuan Begins: Moderate Governance after Yongle
chapters.script_zh: 仁宗即位后，明朝从永乐时期的大工程、远征和高压动员中稍作回收。仁宣之治的重点不是扩张，而是财政、民生和文官治理的稳定。
chapters.script_en: After Hongxi acceded, Ming pulled back somewhat from Yongle’s major projects, campaigns, and high mobilization. Renxuan focused not on expansion but fiscal, livelihood, and civil-administrative stability.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 仁宣之治开端：永乐之后的宽缓治理
chapters.scene_setting_en: Renxuan Begins: Moderate Governance after Yongle
chapters.character_beat_zh: 明朝在皇权、文官和宦官政治之间不断重新分配治理能力。
chapters.character_beat_en: Ming repeatedly reallocates governing capacity among monarchy, civil officials, and eunuch politics.
chapters.story_question_zh: 明朝的稳定和失序，如何在不同皇帝之间交替出现？
chapters.story_question_en: How did Ming stability and disorder alternate across different emperors?

chapters.title_zh: 宣德稳定：明初制度运行成熟
chapters.title_en: Xuande Stability: Early Ming Institutions Mature
chapters.script_zh: 宣德朝延续仁宣路线。三杨等文臣支撑内阁行政，明朝在北方仍面对蒙古压力，但内部治理进入较成熟、可持续的阶段。
chapters.script_en: The Xuande reign continued Renxuan. Ministers like the Three Yangs supported cabinet administration; Ming still faced Mongol pressure, but internal governance became more mature and sustainable.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 宣德稳定：明初制度运行成熟
chapters.scene_setting_en: Xuande Stability: Early Ming Institutions Mature
chapters.character_beat_zh: 明朝在皇权、文官和宦官政治之间不断重新分配治理能力。
chapters.character_beat_en: Ming repeatedly reallocates governing capacity among monarchy, civil officials, and eunuch politics.
chapters.story_question_zh: 明朝的稳定和失序，如何在不同皇帝之间交替出现？
chapters.story_question_en: How did Ming stability and disorder alternate across different emperors?

chapters.title_zh: 土木堡：从扩张自信转向防御焦虑
chapters.title_en: Tumu: From Expansion Confidence to Defensive Anxiety
chapters.script_zh: 土木堡之变中，明英宗被瓦剌俘虏。于谦守住北京，但明朝北方政策从此更趋谨慎和防御。
chapters.script_en: At Tumu, Ming Yingzong was captured by the Oirats. Yu Qian defended Beijing, but Ming northern policy became more cautious and defensive.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 土木堡：从扩张自信转向防御焦虑
chapters.scene_setting_en: Tumu: From Expansion Confidence to Defensive Anxiety

chapters.title_zh: 明武宗：皇权、宦官与中期失序
chapters.title_en: Zhengde: Imperial Power, Eunuchs, and Mid-Ming Disorder
chapters.script_zh: 明武宗即位后，刘瑾等宦官权力膨胀。武宗朝不能只写成逸闻，它说明中期明朝皇权、宦官和文官制度之间的摩擦。
chapters.script_en: After Zhengde acceded, eunuchs such as Liu Jin gained power. The reign is not just anecdote; it shows friction among mid-Ming monarchy, eunuchs, and civil bureaucracy.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 明武宗：皇权、宦官与中期失序
chapters.scene_setting_en: Zhengde: Imperial Power, Eunuchs, and Mid-Ming Disorder
chapters.character_beat_zh: 明朝在皇权、文官和宦官政治之间不断重新分配治理能力。

chapters.story_question_en: How did Ming stability and disorder alternate across different emperors?

chapters.title_zh: 武宗之终：嘉靖前夜的继承问题
chapters.title_en: End of Zhengde: Succession before Jiajing
chapters.script_zh: 武宗无子而终，嘉靖继位。明中期的问题从皇帝个性化统治，转入继承、礼制和朝廷路线之争。
chapters.script_en: Zhengde died without an heir and Jiajing succeeded. Mid-Ming problems moved from personalized rulership into succession, ritual, and court-line struggles.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 武宗之终：嘉靖前夜的继承问题
chapters.scene_setting_en: End of Zhengde: Succession before Jiajing

chapters.title_zh: 俺答汗：中期北边压力仍未消失
chapters.title_en: Altan Khan: Mid-Ming Northern Pressure Remains
chapters.script_zh: 俺答汗逼近北京，说明明朝中期仍然必须处理蒙古诸部、互市、边镇和军费问题。
chapters.script_en: Altan Khan approached Beijing, showing that mid-Ming still had to manage Mongol groups, border trade, garrisons, and military finance.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 俺答汗：中期北边压力仍未消失
chapters.scene_setting_en: Altan Khan: Mid-Ming Northern Pressure Remains

chapters.title_zh: 张居正改革：财政重整的最后强势尝试
chapters.title_en: Zhang Juzheng Reforms: Last Strong Fiscal Reordering
chapters.script_zh: 张居正用考成法和一条鞭法整顿行政财政。这是明朝中后期维持国家能力的重要节点。
chapters.script_en: Zhang Juzheng used administrative audits and the Single Whip system to reorganize fiscal-administrative capacity, a key late-Ming effort to keep the state working.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 张居正改革：财政重整的最后强势尝试
chapters.scene_setting_en: Zhang Juzheng Reforms: Last Strong Fiscal Reordering

chapters.title_zh: 万历后期：财政、战争和官僚疲态
chapters.title_en: Late Wanli: Fiscal, War, and Bureaucratic Fatigue
chapters.script_zh: 万历后期，改革成果逐渐消散，战争和边防成本不断累积。明朝还没崩溃，但国家机器已经显露疲态。
chapters.script_en: In late Wanli, reform gains faded while war and frontier costs accumulated. Ming had not collapsed, but the state machine was visibly fatigued.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 万历后期：财政、战争和官僚疲态
chapters.scene_setting_en: Late Wanli: Fiscal, War, and Bureaucratic Fatigue

chapters.title_zh: 后金出现：东北压力变成王朝挑战
chapters.title_en: Later Jin Appears: Northeast Pressure Becomes Dynastic Challenge
chapters.script_zh: 努尔哈赤建立后金，东北女真力量开始从边患转化为可与明朝争夺天下的政权。1616 的地图还未显示后金独立层，1627 会更清楚。
chapters.script_en: Nurhaci founded Later Jin, turning Jurchen power from frontier trouble into a regime that could contest Ming. The 1616 map does not yet show Later Jin independently; 1627 does.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 后金出现：东北压力变成王朝挑战
chapters.scene_setting_en: Later Jin Appears: Northeast Pressure Becomes Dynastic Challenge

chapters.title_zh: 明熹宗：万历之后、崇祯之前的断裂带
chapters.title_en: Tianqi: The Fault Line between Wanli and Chongzhen
chapters.script_zh: 熹宗即位时，后金已经在辽东形成压力，朝廷内部党争也继续加剧。天启朝是万历后期疲态通向崇祯危局的关键过渡。
chapters.script_en: When Tianqi acceded, Later Jin pressure had formed in Liaodong and factional conflict intensified. The Tianqi reign is the key bridge from late Wanli fatigue to Chongzhen crisis.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 明熹宗：万历之后、崇祯之前的断裂带
chapters.scene_setting_en: Tianqi: The Fault Line between Wanli and Chongzhen

chapters.title_zh: 魏忠贤专权：明末决策机制失衡
chapters.title_en: Wei Zhongxian Dominates: Late Ming Decision-Making Breaks
chapters.script_zh: 魏忠贤专权、打击东林党，使明末朝政更难形成稳定决策。辽东战事、财政困难和党争在这一时期叠加。
chapters.script_en: Wei Zhongxian’s dominance and attacks on Donglin officials made stable decision-making harder. Liaodong war, fiscal strain, and factionalism converged in this period.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 魏忠贤专权：明末决策机制失衡

chapters.title_zh: 崇祯危局：后金、财政与民变叠加
chapters.title_en: Chongzhen Crisis: Later Jin, Finance, and Rebellion Combine
chapters.script_zh: 崇祯即位时，后金已经成形，财政枯竭、党争和地方民变也在扩大。明末危机不是单线外患，而是多重系统失衡。
chapters.script_en: When Chongzhen acceded, Later Jin had formed, fiscal exhaustion, factional conflict, and local unrest were growing. Late Ming crisis was not a single external threat but systemic imbalance.

chapters.scene_setting_en: Chongzhen Crisis: Later Jin, Finance, and Rebellion Combine

chapters.title_zh: 1644：北京陷落与明朝中央灭亡
chapters.title_en: 1644: Beijing Falls and Ming Central Court Ends
chapters.script_zh: 李自成攻入北京，崇祯自缢。1644 是明亡清兴的政治断裂点，但地图要到 1645 才更清楚显示清与南明分立。
chapters.script_en: Li Zicheng entered Beijing and Chongzhen died. 1644 is the political rupture of Ming fall and Qing rise, while the map shows Qing and Southern Ming more clearly in 1645.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 1644：北京陷落与明朝中央灭亡
chapters.scene_setting_en: 1644: Beijing Falls and Ming Central Court Ends

chapters.title_zh: 清与南明：明朝故事转入清初统一
chapters.title_en: Qing and Southern Ming: Ming Story Becomes Qing Unification
chapters.script_zh: 1645 年地图上清朝与南明分立。明朝中央已亡，但南明继续抗清；下一段应进入清朝如何完成统一。
chapters.script_en: In 1645 the map shows Qing and Southern Ming separately. The Ming central court was gone, but Southern Ming resisted; the next story should follow Qing unification.

title_zh: 清朝：入关统一、盛清扩张与近代危机
title_en: Qing Dynasty: Conquest, High Qing Expansion, and Modern Crisis
description_zh: 从清入关后与南明分立开始，讲清朝如何完成统一、处理台湾与三藩、面对俄国和准噶尔、在乾隆时期达到疆域高峰，又如何在鸦片战争、太平天国、洋务、甲午、戊戌、庚子和辛亥中走向终结。
description_en: From Qing’s division with Southern Ming after entering China proper, this storyline follows Qing unification, Taiwan and the Three Feudatories, Russia and Dzungars, High Qing expansion under Qianlong, then Opium War, Taiping, Self-Strengthening, 1895, 1898, Boxer crisis, and Xinhai.
source_note_zh: 地图边界使用 Cliopatria 清朝、南明、准噶尔、太平天国、列强、日本帝国、中华民国等参考层；这些边界适合同代格局展示，不代表逐地审核。
source_note_en: Map boundaries use Cliopatria layers for Qing, Southern Ming, Dzungar, Taiping, empires, Japan, and Republic of China; they are contextual reference boundaries rather than fully reviewed local reconstructions.

chapters.title_zh: 入关之后：清与南明分立
chapters.title_en: After Entry: Qing and Southern Ming Divide
chapters.script_zh: 1645 年地图上清朝与南明分立。清朝已经入主华北，但南方明郑和南明残余仍在，统一还未完成。
chapters.script_en: In 1645 the map shows Qing and Southern Ming separately. Qing held north China, but Southern Ming and Ming loyalist resistance remained; unification was not complete.

chapters.scene_setting_en: After Entry: Qing and Southern Ming Divide

chapters.title_zh: 郑成功据台湾：清初统一仍有海上尾声
chapters.title_en: Koxinga in Taiwan: Maritime Afterlife of Ming Resistance
chapters.script_zh: 1662 年南明残余转向台湾。清朝大陆统治基本成形，但台湾与三藩问题说明清初整合仍在继续。
chapters.script_en: In 1662 Ming loyalist resistance moved to Taiwan. Qing mainland rule was largely formed, but Taiwan and feudatory issues show consolidation continued.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 郑成功据台湾：清初统一仍有海上尾声
chapters.scene_setting_en: Koxinga in Taiwan: Maritime Afterlife of Ming Resistance

chapters.title_zh: 清取台湾：海疆纳入与大陆统一完成
chapters.title_en: Qing Takes Taiwan: Maritime Frontier Incorporated
chapters.script_zh: 1683 年清取台湾，郑氏政权结束。清朝统一从大陆推进到海疆；与此同时，西北准噶尔成为新的内亚挑战。
chapters.script_en: In 1683 Qing took Taiwan and ended Zheng rule. Qing unification moved from the mainland to the maritime frontier while Dzungars became a new Inner Asian challenge.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 清取台湾：海疆纳入与大陆统一完成
chapters.scene_setting_en: Qing Takes Taiwan: Maritime Frontier Incorporated

chapters.title_zh: 尼布楚：清朝的陆上条约边界
chapters.title_en: Nerchinsk: Qing Land Treaty Frontier
chapters.script_zh: 康熙时期与俄国签订尼布楚条约。清朝边疆治理不只是征服，还包括与俄国这样的陆上帝国谈判边界。
chapters.script_en: Under Kangxi, Qing signed Nerchinsk with Russia. Qing frontier governance was not only conquest; it included negotiating borders with land empires.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 尼布楚：清朝的陆上条约边界
chapters.scene_setting_en: Nerchinsk: Qing Land Treaty Frontier

chapters.title_zh: 入藏与雍正治理：内亚秩序和国家能力
chapters.title_en: Tibet and Yongzheng Statecraft: Inner Asia and State Capacity
chapters.script_zh: 1720 年清军入藏，准噶尔压力下的内亚秩序被重组。雍正前后，清朝也通过财政与行政改革强化国家能力。
chapters.script_en: In 1720 Qing entered Tibet and reorganized Inner Asian order under Dzungar pressure. Around Yongzheng, Qing also strengthened fiscal and administrative capacity.

chapters.title_zh: 乾隆平准噶尔：盛清疆域高峰
chapters.title_en: Qianlong Defeats Dzungars: High Qing Territorial Peak
chapters.script_zh: 1759 年准噶尔独立层退出地图，新疆纳入清朝版图。清朝作为内亚帝国达到疆域高峰。
chapters.script_en: In 1759 the Dzungar layer exits the map and Xinjiang enters Qing rule. Qing as an Inner Asian empire reaches its territorial peak.

chapters.scene_setting_en: Qianlong Defeats Dzungars: High Qing Territorial Peak

chapters.title_zh: 马戛尔尼：盛清面对海洋帝国
chapters.title_en: Macartney: High Qing Faces Maritime Empire
chapters.script_zh: 1793 年马戛尔尼使团来华。清朝仍在盛清余晖中，但外部压力正在从内亚边疆转向海洋贸易和工业化帝国。
chapters.script_en: In 1793 Macartney came to China. Qing still stood in High Qing afterglow, but external pressure was shifting from Inner Asia to maritime trade and industrial empires.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 马戛尔尼：盛清面对海洋帝国
chapters.scene_setting_en: Macartney: High Qing Faces Maritime Empire

chapters.title_zh: 南京条约：清朝进入条约体系
chapters.title_en: Treaty of Nanjing: Qing Enters Treaty Order
chapters.script_zh: 鸦片战争后，南京条约打开通商口岸和割让香港。地图上清朝仍大，但主权和外交规则已经改变。
chapters.script_en: After the Opium War, Nanjing opened treaty ports and ceded Hong Kong. The map still shows a large Qing, but sovereignty and diplomacy had changed.

chapters.scene_setting_en: Treaty of Nanjing: Qing Enters Treaty Order

chapters.title_zh: 太平天国：外患之外的内战危机
chapters.title_en: Taiping: Civil War beyond Foreign Pressure
chapters.script_zh: 1851 年太平天国兴起。清朝危机不只是列强压力，内部社会、财政和地方治理也开始断裂。
chapters.script_en: In 1851 Taiping arose. Qing crisis was not only foreign pressure; internal society, finance, and local governance were fracturing.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 太平天国：外患之外的内战危机
chapters.scene_setting_en: Taiping: Civil War beyond Foreign Pressure

chapters.title_zh: 1860：外患与内战同时压顶
chapters.title_en: 1860: Foreign War and Civil War Converge
chapters.script_zh: 1860 年英法联军入北京，太平天国仍在。清朝被迫在内战和外部条约压力之间寻找新办法。
chapters.script_en: In 1860 Anglo-French forces entered Beijing while Taiping continued. Qing had to find new responses between civil war and treaty pressure.

chapters.title_zh: 天京陷落与洋务：地方军政力量上升
chapters.title_en: Tianjing Falls and Self-Strengthening: Provincial Power Rises
chapters.script_zh: 太平天国失败后，曾国藩、李鸿章等地方军政力量上升，洋务运动展开。清朝靠旧制度内的新技术维持下去。
chapters.script_en: After Taiping fell, provincial military-political powers like Zeng and Li rose, and Self-Strengthening expanded. Qing survived through new technology inside old institutions.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 天京陷落与洋务：地方军政力量上升
chapters.scene_setting_en: Tianjing Falls and Self-Strengthening: Provincial Power Rises

chapters.title_zh: 甲午失败：洋务局限暴露
chapters.title_en: 1895 Defeat: Limits of Self-Strengthening Exposed
chapters.script_zh: 甲午战争失败，台湾割让，日本成为东亚新强权。洋务式自强的局限被彻底暴露。
chapters.script_en: Defeat in 1895 ceded Taiwan and revealed Japan as a new East Asian power. The limits of Self-Strengthening were exposed.

chapters.title_zh: 戊戌变法：制度改革的短促尝试
chapters.title_en: Hundred Days: Brief Institutional Reform Attempt
chapters.script_zh: 光绪帝和康有为等推动变法，但很快失败。晚清改革从器物层面推进到制度层面，却撞上权力结构。
chapters.script_en: Guangxu and Kang Youwei pushed reform, but it quickly failed. Late Qing reform moved from technology to institutions but hit the power structure.

chapters.scene_setting_en: Hundred Days: Brief Institutional Reform Attempt

chapters.title_zh: 庚子之变：首都卷入列强战争
chapters.title_en: Boxer Crisis: Capital Drawn into Imperial War
chapters.script_zh: 义和团和八国联军把危机推到北京。清朝随后不得不进行新政，但王朝合法性已经重创。
chapters.script_en: The Boxers and allied invasion brought crisis to Beijing. Qing then had to pursue New Policies, but dynastic legitimacy was deeply damaged.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 庚子之变：首都卷入列强战争
chapters.scene_setting_en: Boxer Crisis: Capital Drawn into Imperial War

chapters.title_zh: 辛亥革命：王朝结构崩解
chapters.title_en: Xinhai Revolution: Dynastic Structure Breaks
chapters.script_zh: 武昌起义后，各省响应。地图上仍是清朝，但政治上中央与地方、朝廷与新军之间的结构已经崩解。
chapters.script_en: After Wuchang, provinces responded. The map still shows Qing, but politically the structure between center, provinces, court, and New Army had broken.

chapters.title_zh: 1912：中华民国建立，帝制结束
chapters.title_en: 1912: Republic Founded, Imperial Era Ends
chapters.script_zh: 1912 年中华民国建立，清帝退位。清朝结束，但疆域、边疆和民族问题进入民国时代。
chapters.script_en: In 1912 the Republic of China was founded and the Qing emperor abdicated. Qing ended, but territorial, frontier, and ethnic questions entered the Republic.

description_zh: 跟随张骞从长安走向西域，看一场失败的外交如何打开欧亚通道。
description_en: Follow Zhang Qian from Chang'an toward the Western Regions and see how a failed mission opened Eurasian routes.
source_note_zh: 地图边界使用 Cliopatria 大洲级参考层；人物路线和讲稿为教学叙事整理。
source_note_en: Map boundaries use Cliopatria continental-scale reference layers; the person route and script are editorial teaching narrative.

route_points.note_zh: 汉武帝派张骞出使西域，希望联络大月氏夹击匈奴。
route_points.note_en: Emperor Wu sent Zhang Qian west to seek a Yuezhi alliance against the Xiongnu.

route_points.note_zh: 河西走廊是汉地通往西域的关键咽喉，也处在匈奴压力之下。
route_points.note_en: The Hexi Corridor was the crucial passage from Han territory toward the Western Regions and lay under Xiongnu pressure.

route_points.note_zh: 张骞被匈奴扣留十余年，个人使命被草原政治格局强行中断。
route_points.note_en: Zhang Qian was detained by the Xiongnu for over a decade, and his mission was interrupted by steppe politics.

route_points.note_zh: 张骞逃离匈奴控制后，没有立即返汉，而是继续寻找大月氏。
route_points.note_en: After escaping Xiongnu control, Zhang Qian did not immediately return to Han but continued searching for the Yuezhi.

route_points.note_zh: 张骞虽未促成军事同盟，却获得了中亚诸国的关键情报。
route_points.note_en: Although Zhang Qian failed to secure the alliance, he gathered crucial intelligence about Central Asian polities.

route_points.note_zh: 张骞带回了关于大宛、康居、大夏等地的情报，改变了汉朝对西方世界的认知。
route_points.note_en: Zhang Qian returned with intelligence about Dayuan, Kangju, Daxia, and other lands, changing Han knowledge of the West.

route_points.note_zh: 汉军夺取河西后，外交情报转化为可持续的战略通道。
route_points.note_en: After Han campaigns secured Hexi, diplomatic intelligence became a durable strategic corridor.

chapters.title_zh: 一个人从长安出发
chapters.title_en: One Envoy Leaves Chang'an
chapters.script_zh: 故事从长安开始。汉武帝面对北方匈奴压力，想寻找一个遥远盟友：大月氏。张骞带着少数随从出发，他不知道前方会有多远，也不知道自己是否还能回来。地图上这一刻看似只是从东向西移动，实际上是汉帝国第一次把战略想象投向中亚。
chapters.script_en: The story begins in Chang'an. Facing Xiongnu pressure in the north, Emperor Wu hoped to find a distant ally: the Yuezhi. Zhang Qian left with a small party, not knowing how far the road would be or whether he would return. On the map this looks like a move westward, but it was Han China's first strategic imagination reaching toward Central Asia.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 长安宫廷与汉帝国西北边界之间。
chapters.scene_setting_en: Between the Chang'an court and the northwestern frontier of the Han Empire.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞不是名将，而是被派去完成一个几乎不可能的外交任务。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian was not a famous general, but an envoy sent on an almost impossible diplomatic mission.
chapters.story_question_zh: 一个人能不能把帝国的视野带到地图之外？
chapters.story_question_en: Can one person carry an empire's vision beyond the edge of its map?

interactions.action_zh: 把寻找大月氏的任务交给张骞。
interactions.action_en: Entrusts Zhang Qian with the mission to find the Yuezhi.
interactions.outcome_zh: 张骞从普通使者变成帝国西行计划的承担者。
interactions.outcome_en: Zhang Qian becomes the carrier of Han westward strategy.

chapters.title_zh: 河西走廊为什么重要
chapters.title_en: Why the Hexi Corridor Mattered
chapters.script_zh: 向西必须经过河西走廊。这里不是地图上的空白通道，而是匈奴、绿洲和帝国边疆交错的压力带。对张骞来说，最难的不是抵达终点，而是先穿过别人控制的门口。故事的危险感从这里开始：他还没有见到大月氏，就已经进入匈奴的视线。
chapters.script_en: To move west, one had to pass through the Hexi Corridor. This was not an empty passage on the map, but a pressure zone where Xiongnu power, oasis routes, and imperial frontiers overlapped. For Zhang Qian, the hardest part was not reaching the destination, but first passing through a doorway controlled by others. The danger begins here: before he ever saw the Yuezhi, he had already entered the Xiongnu field of vision.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 河西走廊，夹在沙漠、山地和草原势力之间。
chapters.scene_setting_en: The Hexi Corridor, squeezed between desert, mountains, and steppe power.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞离开汉地保护范围，进入匈奴影响下的危险通道。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian left the protection of Han territory and entered a dangerous corridor under Xiongnu influence.
chapters.story_question_zh: 如果路本身被敌对势力控制，外交还如何开始？
chapters.story_question_en: If the road itself is controlled by a hostile power, how can diplomacy even begin?

interactions.action_zh: 试图穿过匈奴控制下的通道。
interactions.action_en: Attempts to pass through corridors under Xiongnu control.
interactions.outcome_zh: 外交路线进入敌对权力的视野。
interactions.outcome_en: The diplomatic route enters hostile political sight.

chapters.title_zh: 故事在匈奴那里中断
chapters.title_en: The Story Breaks under Xiongnu Control
chapters.script_zh: 张骞没有顺利穿过草原。他被匈奴扣留，出使任务从地图上的一条路线，变成了十余年的停滞。对观众来说，这一幕很重要：丝路不是从贸易开始的，而是从被拦截、被监视、被迫等待开始的。地图上的线断了，但人物心里的任务还没有断。
chapters.script_en: Zhang Qian did not simply cross the steppe. He was detained by the Xiongnu, and the mission changed from a line on the map into more than a decade of stillness. This scene matters: the Silk Road did not begin with trade, but with interception, surveillance, and forced waiting. The line on the map broke, but the mission inside the person did not.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 匈奴控制下的草原地带，路线突然停止。
chapters.scene_setting_en: The steppe under Xiongnu control, where the route suddenly stops.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞从使者变成俘虏，任务、时间和身份都被迫悬置。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian changed from envoy to captive; his mission, time, and identity were all suspended.
chapters.story_question_zh: 如果使命被中断十余年，它还算没有失败吗？
chapters.story_question_en: If a mission is interrupted for more than a decade, can it still be said not to have failed?

interactions.action_zh: 阻断张骞继续西行，把使者困在草原权力中心。
interactions.action_en: Stops Zhang Qian from continuing west and holds the envoy within steppe power.
interactions.outcome_zh: 路线中断，人物目标被迫进入长期等待。
interactions.outcome_en: The route breaks, and the character goal is forced into long waiting.

chapters.title_zh: 十余年的等待
chapters.title_en: More Than a Decade of Waiting
chapters.script_zh: 这一章几乎没有地图变化，却是人物故事最重的部分。张骞被困多年，汉朝的计划暂时失效，观众看到的是时间的重量：等待、适应、观察、记住。后来他能把西方情报带回汉朝，正因为这些沉默的年份没有白过。
chapters.script_en: This chapter has almost no map movement, yet it is the heaviest part of the character story. Zhang Qian was held for years, and Han plans stalled. What the audience sees is the weight of time: waiting, adapting, observing, remembering. His later intelligence mattered because these silent years were not empty.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 同一片草原，时间从“旅程”变成“岁月”。
chapters.scene_setting_en: The same steppe, where a journey turns into years.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞在异族权力中心长期滞留，必须保存身份、记忆和目标。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian remained for years within a foreign power structure, preserving identity, memory, and purpose.
chapters.story_question_zh: 故事不动的时候，人物还能怎样向前？
chapters.story_question_en: When the story stops moving, how can the character still move forward?

interactions.action_zh: 在扣留中观察草原政治、保留使命记忆。
interactions.action_en: Observes steppe politics during captivity while preserving the mission.
interactions.outcome_zh: 故事没有空间推进，但人物积累了理解世界的经验。
interactions.outcome_en: The story does not move spatially, but the character accumulates world knowledge.

chapters.title_zh: 逃脱后没有回头
chapters.title_en: Escape Without Turning Back
chapters.script_zh: 张骞终于逃脱。按常理，他最安全的选择是立刻返汉；但故事真正的转折在于，他选择继续向西。地图镜头从汉匈边界推向塔里木盆地，人物也从“幸存者”重新变成“使者”。这一刻让故事有了英雄性：不是没有恐惧，而是在恐惧之后仍然选择任务。
chapters.script_en: Zhang Qian finally escaped. The safest choice would have been to return to Han at once. But the turn in the story is that he continued west. The map moves from the Han-Xiongnu frontier toward the Tarim Basin, and the character changes from survivor back into envoy. This is where the story becomes heroic: not because there was no fear, but because the mission was chosen after fear.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 从匈奴控制边缘逃出，转向塔里木盆地与西域绿洲。
chapters.scene_setting_en: Escaping the edge of Xiongnu control and turning toward the Tarim Basin and oasis routes.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞获得重新选择的机会，却没有选择回家。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian regained the chance to choose, but did not choose to go home.
chapters.story_question_zh: 逃出来以后，是活着回去，还是继续完成原来的使命？
chapters.story_question_en: After escaping, should he return alive, or continue the original mission?

interactions.action_zh: 逃脱后不返汉，继续向西寻找大月氏。
interactions.action_en: After escaping, continues west instead of returning to Han.
interactions.outcome_zh: 人物从幸存者重新变成使者。
interactions.outcome_en: The character changes from survivor back into envoy.

chapters.title_zh: 外交失败，知识成功
chapters.title_en: Diplomatic Failure, Knowledge Success
chapters.script_zh: 张骞终于抵达大月氏和更西方的世界。但现实并不按汉朝设想展开：大月氏已经有了新的生活，不愿再回头夹击匈奴。表面看，外交失败了；可张骞看见了大宛、康居、大夏，看见了马匹、城市、道路和贸易。失败没有结束故事，反而把故事从军事同盟转成世界认知。
chapters.script_en: Zhang Qian finally reached the Yuezhi and the farther western world. But reality did not follow Han expectations: the Yuezhi had made a new life and did not want to turn back against the Xiongnu. On the surface, diplomacy failed. Yet Zhang Qian saw Dayuan, Kangju, Daxia, horses, cities, roads, and trade. Failure did not end the story; it changed the story from military alliance to world knowledge.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 中亚边缘，大月氏、大夏与远方政权进入汉朝视野。
chapters.scene_setting_en: The edge of Central Asia, where the Yuezhi, Daxia, and distant polities entered Han vision.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞终于抵达目标，却发现目标并不愿配合汉朝战略。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian finally reached the target, only to discover that the target would not serve Han strategy.
chapters.story_question_zh: 如果外交目标失败，这趟路还留下些什么？
chapters.story_question_en: If the diplomatic objective failed, what did the journey leave behind?

interactions.action_zh: 试图说服大月氏与汉朝合作夹击匈奴。
interactions.action_en: Tries to persuade the Yuezhi to cooperate with Han against the Xiongnu.
interactions.outcome_zh: 结盟失败，但中亚情报被张骞掌握。
interactions.outcome_en: The alliance fails, but Central Asian intelligence is gained.

chapters.title_zh: 返汉：一个人的经历变成国家情报
chapters.title_en: Return to Han: Personal Experience Becomes State Intelligence
chapters.script_zh: 张骞返抵汉朝时，任务目标看似失败，但他带回了路线、政权、物产和距离的情报。这些信息让汉朝第一次能把西方想象成可抵达、可交涉、可经营的空间。个人经历从此进入国家决策，地图上的未知区域开始变成可以行动的世界。
chapters.script_en: When Zhang Qian returned to Han, the original mission looked like a failure. But he brought back intelligence about routes, polities, goods, and distance. This allowed Han leaders to imagine the West as reachable, negotiable, and governable. Personal experience entered state decision-making, and unknown space became an actionable world.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 长安，远方见闻被带回帝国决策中心。
chapters.scene_setting_en: Chang'an, where distant experience returned to the center of imperial decision-making.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞不再只是归来的使者，而是带回一张新世界地图的人。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian was no longer just a returning envoy, but someone who brought back a new mental map of the world.
chapters.story_question_zh: 个人经历如何变成国家战略？
chapters.story_question_en: How does personal experience become state strategy?

interactions.action_zh: 把路线、政权、物产和距离带回汉廷。
interactions.action_en: Brings back routes, polities, goods, and distances to the Han court.
interactions.outcome_zh: 个人经历变成国家情报。
interactions.outcome_en: Personal experience becomes state intelligence.

chapters.title_zh: 个人旅程变成帝国战略
chapters.title_en: A Personal Journey Becomes Imperial Strategy
chapters.script_zh: 几年后，汉军在河西取得突破。张骞带回的地理知识，和汉武帝的军事行动结合起来，最终让一条外交探索路线变成欧亚交流通道。故事的结尾不是“张骞成功了”，而是更大的变化开始了：路线被保护，绿洲被连接，丝路从可能性变成历史进程。
chapters.script_en: Years later, Han armies broke through in Hexi. Zhang Qian's geographic knowledge combined with Emperor Wu's campaigns, turning a diplomatic route into a corridor of Eurasian exchange. The ending is not simply that Zhang Qian succeeded, but that a larger change began: routes were protected, oases were connected, and the Silk Road moved from possibility into historical process.
chapters.scene_setting_zh: 河西走廊重新成为帝国军事与交通战略焦点。
chapters.scene_setting_en: The Hexi Corridor became the focus of imperial military and transport strategy.
chapters.character_beat_zh: 张骞的旅程结束了，但他带回的信息开始改变边疆政策。
chapters.character_beat_en: Zhang Qian's journey ended, but the information he brought back began reshaping frontier policy.
chapters.story_question_zh: 一段个人旅程怎样变成一条欧亚通道？
chapters.story_question_en: How does one person's journey become a Eurasian corridor?

interactions.action_zh: 把张骞见闻转化为河西经营和西域政策。
interactions.action_en: Turns Zhang Qian’s knowledge into Hexi strategy and Western Regions policy.
interactions.outcome_zh: 人物旅程开始改变帝国地图。
interactions.outcome_en: A personal journey begins to alter the imperial map.

narrative_intro.text_zh: 起初，西汉的疆域被局限在玉门关以东。为了联合大月氏夹击匈奴，[张骞](zhang_qian_west_-138)踏上了九死一生的西行之路，却很快[被匈奴扣留](zhang_qian_captured_xiongnu_-138)。十余年后，他[逃脱继续西行](zhang_qian_escapes_xiongnu_-129)，虽然军事同盟未能达成，却带回了西域的广阔情报。随后，汉武帝发动了[河西之战](emperor_wu_expansion_-121)，打通了通往西方的咽喉。从[丝绸之路](silk_road_growth_-119)开始，东方的丝绸与西方的汗血宝马开始了数千年的交换。
narrative_intro.text_en: Initially, the Western Han was confined east of the Yumen Pass. To form an alliance with the Yuezhi against the Xiongnu, [Zhang Qian](zhang_qian_west_-138) embarked on a perilous journey west, but was soon [detained by the Xiongnu](zhang_qian_captured_xiongnu_-138). More than a decade later, he [escaped and continued west](zhang_qian_escapes_xiongnu_-129). Although the military alliance failed, he brought back vast intelligence about the Western Regions. Later, Emperor Wu launched the [Hexi Campaign](emperor_wu_expansion_-121), opening the throat to the West. With the [Silk Road](silk_road_growth_-119), the exchange of Eastern silk for Western Ferghana horses began a millennia-long trade.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 如果没有战争的迫切需求，丝绸之路还会被开拓吗？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: Without the urgent need for war, would the Silk Road still have been opened?

characters.goal_zh: 联络大月氏，寻找夹击匈奴的可能。
characters.goal_en: Reach the Yuezhi and explore an alliance against the Xiongnu.

characters.role_zh: 派遣者 / 帝国决策者
characters.goal_zh: 突破匈奴压力，打开西向战略空间。
characters.goal_en: Break Xiongnu pressure and open a westward strategic horizon.

characters.goal_zh: 控制草原通道，阻止汉朝联络西方势力。
characters.goal_en: Control steppe corridors and prevent Han contact with western powers.

characters.goal_zh: 在中亚维持新的生活，不愿为汉朝战略重新东返复仇。
characters.goal_en: Maintain a new life in Central Asia rather than return east for Han strategy.

characters.goal_zh: 把远方见闻转化为边疆政策和路线经营。
characters.goal_en: Turn distant knowledge into frontier policy and route strategy.
